title: Development of interactive software for a digital dermatoscope
summary:
The dermatoscope is used for participating patients with a suspected skin tumor or a precursor in the routine in the same way as a dermatoscope would otherwise be used. In contrast to routine use, the image data is stored pseudonymously together with the age, gender, skin type, localization of the measurement and other information on tanning, skin color, ethnicity for the development of artificial intelligence.
Following the routine removal and histological findings or successful treatment, the collected data is evaluated with the findings.
conditions: Melanoma and other malignant neoplasms of skin

interventions.name: Patients with suspected skin tumors or precursors are examined once with a digital dermatoscope before the lesion is removed or treated. Dermatoscopic images are evaluated with a confirmed diagnosis.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- who are suspected of having a skin tumor or a precursor and a confirmed diagnosis is available after further treatment.
- who have been informed about the aims of the study and the nature of the examinations.
- who have given their written informed consent to participate.
Exclusion criteria:
- children
- Persons who have not given their informed consent in writing
- Persons who cannot make decisions on their own responsibility
